story.title: The Lantern Archive
story.originality: Original fictional fixture written for Fork Night. No imported franchise, real person, or third-party reference image.

characters.description: Mara is an adult map conservator in a coral jacket, carrying a brass lantern.
Later version: Mara has a blue climbing harness. Do not inherit before the rooftop moment.
Oss is an imaginary paper moth that lives in the archive's west wing.

references.description: Original text reference: an indigo archive, warm rectangular windows, brass lamp, a crescent canal.
Later reference: copper telescope and rooftop observatory.
Sibling reference: a room filled with folded paper moths.

moments.summary: Mara discovers that one chart in the archive has begun to glow.
captions: The last lamp should have gone dark.
One chart kept its own light.

moments.summary: Mara carries the chart to the canal and discovers its light points upstream.
captions: The canal answered in circles.
The map was pointing home.

moments.summary: Mara reaches the observatory in a blue climbing harness.
captions: Above the archive, another map waited.
The sky had remembered her.

moments.summary: Instead of leaving, Mara enters the west wing and meets Oss.
captions: Something folded itself out of the map.
Its wings were covered in streets.
Draft only.
Do not inherit.

experiments.title: Continue only the seed-to-canal path
experiments.prompt: Mara raises her brass lantern. The canal reflects a tiny new doorway that was not there before. Keep her coral jacket and the archive's indigo palette.
captions: She raised the lantern a little higher.
The water remembered a door.

experiments.title: Recreate from visible descriptions without paid ancestry
experiments.prompt: Using only this visible description, recreate an acceptable starting point: an adult map conservator in a coral jacket holds a brass lantern by an indigo archive and a crescent canal. A glowing map points upstream. This is a separate comparison, not inherited continuity.
captions: A map, a canal, a familiar light.
Would this be the same beginning?

experiments.title: Accepted request, lost reply, recover by request key
experiments.prompt: Mara follows the lantern light toward the canal doorway.
captions: The reply was lost.
The same saved result was found.

experiments.title: Accepted request cannot be reconciled; keep allowance held
experiments.prompt: Mara waits while the canal doorway glows.
captions: Some work may have happened.
Do not buy it again blindly.

experiments.title: Recover saved output after an interrupted artifact write
experiments.prompt: Mara opens the canal doorway and finds a room of maps.
captions: The first panel had been saved.
Both returned without another generation.
